column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 11 (M24011): Commander & AR Team masuk Nirvana, bertemu M4A1,
# reuni penuh, lalu bersiap membereskan fantom sebelum mengejar Ateraxis.
# Tetap Inggris: Commander, The Elmo, Melanie, Helen, Helena, Nirvana, Dandelion, M4,
# M4A1, Groza, Mokosh, Yellow Zone, Paradeus, Ateraxis, Lviv, Asteria, Soppo, RO, SOP2,
# M16, Beluga, Robella, AR Team, Boojum, neural cloud, M16A1, M4 SOPMOD II, ST AR-15,
# RO635, Reverse Collapse, Doll, Doll Community.

(The same feeling as in Lviv struck. The perception of the surroundings and the identification of the self were gradually stripped away. The familiar world turned into strange colors, and information never understood before flooded into the mind.)
column2: (Perasaan yang sama seperti di Lviv menghantam. Persepsi terhadap sekeliling dan pengenalan atas diri sendiri berangsur ditanggalkan. Dunia yang kukenal berubah menjadi warna-warna aneh, dan informasi yang belum pernah kupahami membanjir ke kepalaku.)

column1: (I held Melanie tightly and walked forward step by step, until a strong hand supported us.)
column2: (Aku memeluk Melanie kuat-kuat dan melangkah maju setapak demi setapak, sampai sebuah tangan yang kokoh menopang kami.)

column1: Commander! We have to abandon The Elmo—already.
column2: Commander! Kita harus meninggalkan The Elmo—sekarang.

column1: It's the only way...
column2: Hanya itu caranya...

column1: (We were out of options in every situation. At least we managed to rescue Helen and Melanie.)
column2: (Kami kehabisan pilihan di segala situasi. Setidaknya kami berhasil menyelamatkan Helen dan Melanie.)

column1: (No human or Doll should stay here. However, it might already be too late now... Are we already in the world of Nirvana?)
column2: (Tidak ada manusia atau Doll yang boleh tinggal di sini. Namun sekarang mungkin sudah terlambat... Apa kami sudah berada di dunia Nirvana?)

column1: (Suddenly, a figure walked towards us. Around 'her', the restless crimson became peaceful and calm. As she parted her lips to speak softly, the ethereal voice didn't come through hearing, but rather seemed to pierce through the soul of the entire body directly from the heart.)
column2: (Tiba-tiba sebuah figur melangkah ke arah kami. Di sekeliling 'dia', warna merah tua yang gelisah menjadi damai dan tenang. Saat dia membuka bibirnya dan berbicara lirih, suara halus itu tidak datang lewat pendengaran, tapi seolah menembus jiwa seluruh tubuh langsung dari dalam hati.)

column1: 指挥官。
column2: Commander.

column1: Dandelion! You're okay—
column2: Dandelion! Kau tidak apa-apa—

column1: (Some kind of cognition sharper than reason stopped my voice.)
column2: (Semacam kesadaran yang lebih tajam dari nalar menghentikan suaraku.)

column1: (The girl before me had black hair falling to her shoulders, her tranquil eyes innocent and clear. Her demeanor revealed a transcendent temperament that neither humans nor Dolls could imitate. It didn't match Dandelion's usual lively and teasing expression, but pointed to another figure in my memory. In her, I sensed an indescribable intimacy, nostalgic like homesickness, yet also like a piercing pain.)
column2: (Gadis di depanku berambut hitam yang jatuh sampai bahu, matanya tenang, lugu, dan jernih. Sikapnya memperlihatkan aura melampaui dunia yang tidak bisa ditiru manusia maupun Doll. Itu tidak cocok dengan ekspresi Dandelion yang biasanya lincah dan suka meledek, tapi menunjuk ke figur lain di ingatanku. Pada dirinya aku merasakan kedekatan yang tak bisa dijelaskan, mengharukan seperti rindu rumah, tapi juga seperti nyeri yang menusuk.)

column1: Is it... you?
column2: Apa... itu kau?

column1: Please come with me, I need your help.
column2: Tolong ikut denganku, aku butuh bantuanmu.

column1: ...Is this matter important?
column2: ...Apa urusan ini penting?

column1: Indeed.
column2: Sangat.

column1: (At a time like this, the request she made of me is undoubtedly a huge test.)
column2: (Di saat seperti ini, permintaannya kepadaku tidak diragukan adalah ujian yang besar.)

column1: (The Elmo has suffered heavy damage, Mokosh is under siege, various parts of the Yellow Zone are engulfed in war, and Paradeus and the conglomerate are beginning to bare their fangs; there are still so many things waiting for me to complete, and so many people have placed their high hopes on me. Even a momentary dereliction of duty would be a massive failure.)
column2: (The Elmo rusak berat, Mokosh dikepung, berbagai bagian Yellow Zone tertelan perang, dan Paradeus serta konglomerat mulai memperlihatkan giginya; masih begitu banyak hal yang menunggu kuselesaikan, dan begitu banyak orang yang menaruh harapan besar padaku. Meninggalkan tugas walau sesaat pun akan jadi kegagalan yang masif.)

column1: (On the other hand, "she" has never made a request of me before.)
column2: (Di sisi lain, "dia" belum pernah meminta apa pun dariku sebelumnya.)

column1: (I have already witnessed all of that. The scenes in Nirvana that far exceed common sense and subvert all past concepts are closely related to this world. Although I don't know what kind of effect I can have... I know I have no choice.)
column2: (Aku sudah menyaksikan semua itu. Pemandangan di Nirvana yang jauh melampaui akal sehat dan menjungkirkan semua konsep lama berkaitan erat dengan dunia ini. Meski aku tidak tahu seberapa besar pengaruh yang bisa kuberikan... aku tahu aku tidak punya pilihan.)

column1: Groza, I need to leave for a bit. You will take over all my duties next—protect The Elmo and the Doll Community, and try to rescue everyone in Mokosh.
column2: Groza, aku harus pergi sebentar. Kau yang mengambil alih semua tugasku setelah ini—lindungi The Elmo dan Doll Community, dan usahakan menyelamatkan semua orang di Mokosh.

column1: Also, take Melanie and Helena away as soon as possible.
column2: Dan juga, bawa Melanie serta Helena menjauh secepat mungkin.

column1: (I walked towards Groza and placed Melanie in her arms as well.)
column2: (Aku melangkah ke arah Groza dan menaruh Melanie di pelukannya juga.)

column1: (Although she and Helena were still unconscious, compared to how Helena looked last time in Lviv, they seemed much better—perhaps because Ateraxis and the dragon were too powerful... or maybe because... someone was here.)
column2: (Meski dia dan Helena masih tidak sadarkan diri, dibanding kondisi Helena waktu di Lviv dulu, keduanya tampak jauh lebih baik—mungkin karena Ateraxis dan naga itu terlalu kuat... atau mungkin karena... ada seseorang di sini.)

column1: Commander... where... where are you going?
column2: Commander... kau... kau mau ke mana?

column1: (Groza shuddered, revealing a sorrowful and panicked look. She suddenly turned to 'Dandelion' and then looked at me again.)
column2: (Groza tersentak, memperlihatkan wajah sedih dan panik. Dia tiba-tiba menoleh ke 'Dandelion' lalu kembali menatapku.)

column1: I think it's an important long-distance mission. I'll be back soon, trust me.
column2: Kurasa ini misi jarak jauh yang penting. Aku akan segera kembali, percayalah padaku.

column1: Since you put it that way... it must be a mission you have to go on, right?
column2: Karena kau bilang begitu... berarti ini misi yang harus kau jalani, kan?

column1: ...I understand. I believe in you, Commander. No matter how long it takes, The Elmo and I will always be waiting for you.
column2: ...Aku paham. Aku percaya padamu, Commander. Selama apa pun waktunya, aku dan The Elmo akan selalu menunggumu.

column1: (Burning emotions dried the tears in her eyes, and Groza gave me a firm salute.)
column2: (Emosi yang membara mengeringkan air mata di matanya, dan Groza memberiku hormat yang mantap.)

column1: (She turned around and brushed past four other Dolls approaching her.)
column2: (Dia berbalik dan melewati empat Doll lain yang mendekat ke arahnya.)

column1: Commander! Dandelion... No, you... you're not Dandelion.
column2: Commander! Dandelion... Bukan, kau... kau bukan Dandelion.

column1: This time... it's really you, isn't it?
column2: Kali ini... ini benar-benar kau, kan?

column1: Hmph... Are you going to use Reverse... Collapse? Who exactly are you?
column2: Hmph... Kau akan memakai Reverse... Collapse? Kau sebenarnya siapa?

column1: This, this scent, could it be, you are...!?
column2: Ini, aroma ini, jangan-jangan, kau...!?

column1: I'm sorry, everyone—we'll have to talk over there.
column2: Maafkan aku, semuanya—kita bicara di sana.

column1: (As soon as "Dandelion" finishes speaking, the deck of The Elmo and the entire world fall away beneath my feet, and I seem to be sucked into the sky, ascending endlessly.)
column2: (Begitu "Dandelion" selesai bicara, dek The Elmo dan seluruh dunia runtuh dari bawah kakiku, dan aku seolah tersedot ke langit, naik tanpa henti.)

column1: (When my feet touch "solid ground" again, what meets my eyes is a suffocating darkness.)
column2: (Saat kakiku kembali menyentuh "tanah padat", yang menyambut mataku adalah kegelapan yang menyesakkan.)

column1: (In this dimension known as "Nirvana", there is no flow of wind, no refraction of light. Everything seems to be sealed in absolutely still amber.)
column2: (Di dimensi yang dikenal sebagai "Nirvana" ini, tidak ada aliran angin, tidak ada pembiasan cahaya. Segalanya seolah tersegel dalam damar yang benar-benar tidak bergerak.)

column1: (Time, space, and even the weight of life itself are stripped completely bare in this nothingness, becoming meaningless.)
column2: (Waktu, ruang, bahkan bobot kehidupan itu sendiri ditanggalkan telanjang di dalam ketiadaan ini, menjadi tanpa makna.)

column1: (I closed my eyes, following that faint yet omnipresent voice, using it as the sole standard to anchor the concept. Discarding pure senses, I used my consciousness to sculpt the chaos before me into the appearance I saw the moment the door opened.)
column2: (Aku menutup mata, mengikuti suara samar yang ada di mana-mana itu, memakainya sebagai satu-satunya patokan untuk menjangkarkan konsepnya. Menyingkirkan panca indera semata, aku memakai kesadaranku untuk memahat kekacauan di depanku menjadi bentuk yang kulihat saat pintunya terbuka.)

column1: (Smash—)
column2: (Prak—)

column1: (When my gaze focused once again, the scene in my eyes finally transformed from an invisible concept into a structure I could recognize.)
column2: (Saat pandanganku kembali fokus, pemandangan di mataku akhirnya berubah dari konsep yang tak terlihat menjadi struktur yang bisa kukenali.)

column1: (The smell of gunpowder first stimulated my sense of smell, followed by the crimson sky and war-torn earth invading my vision.)
column2: (Bau mesiu lebih dulu merangsang hidungku, disusul langit merah tua dan tanah yang koyak perang menyerbu penglihatanku.)

column1: (No, these aren't important.)
column2: (Bukan, itu semua tidak penting.)

column1: (I looked around, wanting first to confirm the figures who had fought alongside me on countless smoke-filled nights, only to be scattered time and again in the torrent of fate.)
column2: (Aku memandang sekeliling, ingin lebih dulu memastikan figur-figur yang pernah bertarung bersamaku di malam-malam berasap yang tak terhitung, tapi berkali-kali terpencar dalam arus takdir.)

column1: Ugh... there seems to be something in my neural cloud... Soppo, where are you?
column2: Ugh... sepertinya ada sesuatu di neural cloud-ku... Soppo, kau di mana?

column1: I'm here, everyone's here! But where is this place!
column2: Aku di sini, semuanya di sini! Tapi ini tempat apa!

column1: —It's Nirvana.
column2: —Ini Nirvana.

column1: Not bad...
column2: Tidak buruk...

column1: You...
column2: Kau...

column1: (Asteria is not distracted by anything. From the very beginning—before we entered this domain, and after we entered here—her gaze and line of sight have never left that person from start to finish.)
column2: (Asteria tidak teralihkan oleh apa pun. Sejak awal—sebelum kami masuk ke ranah ini, dan setelah kami masuk—tatapan dan garis pandangnya sama sekali tidak pernah lepas dari orang itu.)

column1: (As if she's worried she might vanish like a bubble at any moment.)
column2: (Seolah dia khawatir orang itu bisa hilang seperti gelembung kapan saja.)

column1: (And following her voice and gaze, we all hold our breath in unison, locking our eyes firmly on the "Dandelion" before us.)
column2: (Dan mengikuti suara serta tatapannya, kami semua menahan napas serentak, mengunci mata kami pada "Dandelion" di depan kami.)

column1: ...Long time no see.
column2: ...Lama tidak bertemu.

column1: RO, 15, SOP2, M16, and... Commander.
column2: RO, 15, SOP2, M16, dan... Commander.

column1: (The appearance, clothing, and even the curve of the falling hair of that body have not changed at all, but the light flowing deep in those eyes, and the serene temperament that has settled after crossing countless dimensions, are announcing the arrival of a miracle.)
column2: (Wajah, pakaian, bahkan lengkung rambut yang jatuh dari tubuh itu sama sekali tidak berubah, tapi cahaya yang mengalir di dasar mata itu, dan aura tenang yang mengendap setelah melintasi dimensi yang tak terhitung, sedang mengumumkan datangnya sebuah keajaiban.)

column1: (This beautiful illusion, like a revolving lantern, made me and everyone in the AR Team afraid to blink easily, for fear that this was really just a fragile morning dream.)
column2: (Ilusi indah bagai lampion berputar itu membuat aku dan semua anggota AR Team takut mengerjap sembarangan, khawatir ini benar-benar hanya mimpi pagi yang rapuh.)

column1: (Without a doubt, she is—)
column2: (Tidak diragukan, dia adalah—)

column1: ...Is that you? M4?
column2: ...Itu kau? M4?

column1: It's so good to be able to see you like this.
column2: Sungguh baik bisa melihatmu seperti ini.

column1: Yes, it's me, Commander.
column2: Ya, ini aku, Commander.

column1: (The curve of the girl's lips was as gentle and warm as in my memory. She slightly lowered her eyes, folded her hands, and gave me a slightly reserved yet impeccable bow.)
column2: (Lengkung bibir gadis itu selembut dan sehangat yang ada di ingatanku. Dia menundukkan matanya sedikit, merapatkan tangannya, dan memberiku bungkukan yang agak tertahan tapi tanpa cela.)

column1: (Her graceful movements were like a butterfly that, after weathering storms, finally folded its wings on the tip of a leaf in its homeland.)
column2: (Gerakannya yang elegan seperti kupu-kupu yang, setelah melewati badai, akhirnya melipat sayapnya di ujung sebuah daun di kampungnya.)

column1: (Even though my brain had rehearsed this millions of times, the moment I truly saw her, my breath still caught for half a second.)
column2: (Meski otakku sudah melatih adegan ini jutaan kali, saat benar-benar melihatnya, napasku tetap tersangkut setengah detik.)

column1: (Almost immediately after M4A1 admits her identity, the red figure rushes into the girl's arms.)
column2: (Nyaris seketika setelah M4A1 mengakui identitasnya, figur merah itu menghambur ke pelukan gadis tersebut.)

column1: SOP2... no, you have your own name now. Soppo... sorry for making you worry.
column2: SOP2... bukan, sekarang kau punya namamu sendiri. Soppo... maaf sudah membuatmu khawatir.

column1: Waaaaah... M4!!!!!
column2: Huwaaaa... M4!!!!!

column1: Yeah, I'm right here.
column2: Iya, aku di sini.

column1: (Beluga, who had been keeping her guard up against the scene before her since just now, seems to understand something in this instant. She finally drops her tense expression, becomes relieved, and restores that smiling face I am familiar with.)
column2: (Beluga yang sejak tadi menjaga kewaspadaan terhadap pemandangan di depannya seolah memahami sesuatu dalam sekejap. Dia akhirnya melepas ekspresi tegangnya, lega, dan memulihkan wajah tersenyum yang kukenal.)

column1: This scene looks really familiar. I remember, Soppo doesn't hold back with this move.
column2: Pemandangan ini rasanya familier sekali. Kalau kuingat, Soppo tidak menahan diri kalau memakai jurus itu.

column1: It hurts the chest a lot when she crashes into you.
column2: Dadanya sakit sekali kalau dia menabrakmu.

column1: ...The pain is what you deserve to endure, especially you.
column2: ...Sakitnya memang pantas kau tanggung, terutama kau.

column1: Eh? Me? Why are you targeting me? I'm not the only one here who 'ran away from home', right?
column2: Eh? Aku? Kenapa aku yang disasar? Bukan cuma aku yang 'kabur dari rumah' di sini, kan?

column1: Although M4 has been away from us the longest, we know she had no choice.
column2: Meski M4 paling lama jauh dari kami, kami tahu dia tidak punya pilihan.

column1: Moreover, she has always kept us in her thoughts in her own way. I know, I've always known... although we can't see her, she has always been by our side.
column2: Lebih dari itu, dia selalu menyimpan kami di pikirannya dengan caranya sendiri. Aku tahu, aku selalu tahu... meski kami tidak bisa melihatnya, dia selalu ada di sisi kami.

column1: Unlike you, always appearing suddenly and disappearing suddenly, not considering others' feelings at all!
column2: Tidak sepertimu, selalu muncul tiba-tiba dan hilang tiba-tiba, sama sekali tidak memikirkan perasaan orang lain!

column1: That's right... two guys who don't give people peace of mind.
column2: Benar... dua orang yang tidak pernah membuat orang tenang.

column1: Don't think you can wash your hands of this! 15!
column2: Jangan pikir kau bisa lepas tangan dari ini! 15!

column1: The three of us were the last ones holding the line together, but you always acted on your own, leaving just me and Soppo behind.
column2: Kami bertiga yang terakhir menahan garis itu bersama, tapi kau selalu bergerak sendiri, meninggalkan aku dan Soppo saja.

column1: If anyone's being selfish, you're the worst of all!
column2: Kalau bicara egois, kau yang paling parah!

column1: Hah!? I... I was... I did not...
column2: Hah!? Aku... aku... aku tidak...

column1: I had no other choice!
column2: Aku tidak punya pilihan lain!

column1: Wuuwaaaaaahhh—!!
column2: Huwaaaaaaa—!!

column1: (Without needing any orders, the members of the AR Team spontaneously tightened their formation, firmly guarding M4A1 and me in the very center.)
column2: (Tanpa perlu perintah, anggota AR Team dengan sendirinya merapatkan formasi, menjaga M4A1 dan aku tepat di tengah dengan kokoh.)

column1: (Their usual calmness and restraint were completely thrown to the wind at this moment. All that remained was the pure joy brought by reunion in their neural clouds and hearts.)
column2: (Ketenangan dan kekangan diri mereka yang biasa dilempar habis ke angin saat itu. Yang tersisa hanya kegembiraan murni karena reuni, di neural cloud maupun di hati mereka.)

column1: (Soppo threw herself into M4A1's arms, tightly gripping her long dress. Like a puppy that had finally found its owner, she greedily buried her cheek against her chest, rubbing and howling continuously, as if trying to vent all the loneliness and grievances of the past ten years all at once.)
column2: (Soppo melempar dirinya ke pelukan M4A1, mencengkeram kuat gaun panjangnya. Seperti anak anjing yang akhirnya menemukan pemiliknya, dia dengan rakus membenamkan pipinya ke dada M4A1, terus menggosok dan meraung, seolah ingin meluapkan seluruh kesepian dan keluh sepuluh tahun sekaligus.)

column1: (M4 gently stroked the top of Soppo's head while patting her back to soothe her emotions. She looked tenderly at the somewhat noisy other three, the softness in her gaze showing that she had been waiting for this moment for a very, very long time.)
column2: (M4 mengusap lembut puncak kepala Soppo sembari menepuk punggungnya untuk menenangkan emosinya. Dia menatap tiga orang lain yang agak berisik itu dengan lembut, dan kelembutan di tatapannya menunjukkan dia sudah sangat, sangat lama menunggu momen ini.)

column1: (Faced with Robella's "accusation," both Beluga and Asteria seemed a bit awkward, but didn't know how to refute it—or perhaps there was no need to refute it at all. At this moment, they were simply using this kind of conversation to try and calm their agitated feelings.)
column2: (Menghadapi "tuduhan" Robella, Beluga dan Asteria tampak agak kikuk, tapi tidak tahu bagaimana membantahnya—atau mungkin tidak perlu dibantah sama sekali. Saat itu mereka hanya memakai percakapan seperti itu untuk mencoba menenangkan perasaan mereka yang bergejolak.)

column1: ...I'm sorry, Robella.
column2: ...Maafkan aku, Robella.

column1: No matter what the reasons were, in the end, the cause that led to everyone's separation ultimately lies with me.
column2: Apa pun alasannya, pada akhirnya sebab yang membuat semua orang terpisah ada padaku.

column1: Whether it's M16 or Asteria, they've both been running around tirelessly because of me.
column2: Baik M16 maupun Asteria, keduanya berlarian tanpa lelah karena aku.

column1: Even you and Soppo... and the Commander, have always been silently missing me.
column2: Bahkan kau dan Soppo... dan Commander, selalu merindukanku dalam diam.

column1: I know it all, yet I've never been able to give you a response.
column2: Aku tahu semuanya, tapi aku tidak pernah bisa memberi kalian jawaban.

column1: This is all my responsibility.
column2: Ini semua tanggung jawabku.

column1: ...Don't blame yourself, you don't need to blame yourself, M4.
column2: ...Jangan menyalahkan dirimu, kau tidak perlu menyalahkan dirimu, M4.

column1: None of this matters anymore. At this moment, right now, saying those things is meaningless.
column2: Semua itu tidak penting lagi. Saat ini, sekarang, mengatakan hal seperti itu tidak ada gunanya.

column1: We are here... that's what's most important.
column2: Kita ada di sini... itu yang paling penting.

column1: (M4 raises her head, her gaze meeting mine.)
column2: (M4 mengangkat kepalanya, tatapannya bertemu tatapanku.)

column1: (She looks at me gratefully, her eyes filled with a complex mix of emotions.)
column2: (Dia menatapku dengan penuh syukur, matanya dipenuhi campuran emosi yang rumit.)

column1: (She is no deity. At this moment, the one standing before me is still the same girl from the past.)
column2: (Dia bukan dewa. Saat ini, yang berdiri di depanku tetap gadis yang sama seperti dulu.)

column1: (—I realize it.)
column2: (—Aku menyadarinya.)

column1: ...You also feel very happy and excited, right?
column2: ...Kau juga merasa sangat senang dan bersemangat, kan?

column1: Could it be that the omniscient and omnipotent M4, when faced with the joy of reunion, also doesn't know what to do or what to say?
column2: Jangan-jangan M4 yang mahatahu dan mahakuasa ini, saat menghadapi kegembiraan reuni, juga tidak tahu harus bagaimana dan bilang apa?

column1: (Faced with my teasing, M4 showed a hint of dissatisfaction.)
column2: (Menghadapi godaanku, M4 memperlihatkan sedikit rasa tidak senang.)

column1: (...Just like in the past.)
column2: (...Sama seperti dulu.)

column1: ...No, you're right.
column2: ...Tidak, kau benar.

column1: I'm sorry, everyone, I seem to have been putting on airs a bit too much.
column2: Maafkan aku, semuanya, sepertinya aku terlalu banyak berlagak.

column1: Although there are many things I want to say, right now, there is only one thing I should say.
column2: Meski ada banyak hal yang ingin kukatakan, sekarang hanya ada satu hal yang harus kukatakan.

column1: Everyone, all of you.
column2: Semuanya, kalian semua.

column1: ...I missed you all so much.
column2: ...Aku sangat merindukan kalian.

column1: Waaaaahhhhh!!!! M4!!! Commander!!!! 15!!!!! M16!!!!! Everyone, everyone, wuuuuuuu!!!!!!! This is so great waaaaaahhhhh!!!!!!!
column2: Huwaaaaaa!!!! M4!!! Commander!!!! 15!!!!! M16!!!!! Semuanya, semuanya, huhuuuuu!!!!!!! Ini bagus sekali huwaaaaaa!!!!!!!

column1: Uh... wait, wait, Soppo... your strength... is a bit...
column2: Eh... tunggu, tunggu, Soppo... tenagamu... agak...

column1: ...Asteria? 15? Your expression is scary.
column2: ...Asteria? 15? Ekspresimu menakutkan.

column1: No, don't join in without saying a word like this... it makes me think of...
column2: Jangan, jangan ikut-ikutan tanpa bicara seperti ini... jadi mengingatkanku pada...

column1: ...Will you go back? Back to... 'her'?
column2: ...Kau akan kembali? Kembali ke... 'dia'?

column1: Heh... to actually ask something like that, I'm really pathetic.
column2: Heh... sampai menanyakan hal seperti itu, aku benar-benar menyedihkan.

column1: Alright, come let Big Sis give you a hug—I missed you too.
column2: Sudah, sini biar Big Sis memelukmu—aku juga merindukanmu.

column1: (Looking at the scene before her, Robella's face beams with the most intense smile since I've known her.)
column2: (Menatap pemandangan di depannya, wajah Robella memancarkan senyum paling lebar sejak aku mengenalnya.)

column1: (Silent tears overflowed from her eyes, but she seemed not to notice, just letting them fall in large drops.)
column2: (Air mata yang tanpa suara meluap dari matanya, tapi dia sepertinya tidak menyadarinya, hanya membiarkannya jatuh dalam tetes-tetes besar.)

column1: (I suddenly realized that this might be the first and only time I know of that the AR Team has truly gathered together like this.)
column2: (Aku tiba-tiba menyadari ini mungkin kali pertama dan satu-satunya yang kutahu bahwa AR Team benar-benar berkumpul lengkap seperti ini.)

column1: Let's join them.
column2: Ayo ikut bergabung.

column1: If you don't go soon, Soppo is going to cry even louder.
column2: Kalau tidak cepat, Soppo akan menangis lebih kencang.

column1: Waaaaaah—M4! 15! M16! RO—Waaaaaah—!!!
column2: Huwaaaaa—M4! 15! M16! RO—Huwaaaaa—!!!

column1: ...Yeah!
column2: ...Iya!

column1: (Soppo wrapped her arms around everyone, as if wanting to hold us all in her embrace. We squeezed together like a tightly packed dumpling.)
column2: (Soppo merentangkan tangannya memeluk semua orang, seolah ingin memuat kami semua dalam pelukannya. Kami berjejal jadi satu seperti lemper yang dipadatkan.)

column1: (I remembered that I had seen a scene like this before, only this time, it was more complete.)
column2: (Aku ingat pernah melihat pemandangan seperti ini, hanya saja kali ini lebih lengkap.)

column1: (Perhaps to make up for the last time, and all the regrets of the past ten years, the AR Team tightly embraced each other just like this.)
column2: (Mungkin untuk menebus yang terakhir kali, dan semua penyesalan sepuluh tahun ini, AR Team berpelukan erat seperti itu.)

column1: (In this brief moment, I also reached out, trying my best to embrace them, commemorating this rare time.)
column2: (Dalam momen singkat itu, aku juga mengulurkan tangan, berusaha sebisa mungkin memeluk mereka, memperingati waktu yang langka ini.)

column1: (M4 and Asteria leaned quietly against my shoulder. Crystal tears slipped from the corners of M4's eyes, instantly turning into brilliant fireflies scattering in the void.)
column2: (M4 dan Asteria bersandar dalam diam di bahuku. Air mata sebening kristal meluncur dari sudut mata M4, seketika berubah menjadi kunang-kunang gemerlap yang berserak di kekosongan.)

column1: Everyone... Commander... I... I...
column2: Semuanya... Commander... aku... aku...

column1: It's okay, you don't have to force yourself to say anything...
column2: Tidak apa-apa, kau tidak perlu memaksakan diri mengatakan apa pun...

column1: Right! It's not M4's fault, it's Asteria and M16's fault! Especially M16!
column2: Benar! Ini bukan salah M4, ini salah Asteria dan M16! Terutama M16!

column1: Eh... is my credibility really that bad?
column2: Eh... kredibilitasku seburuk itu?

column1: No one has worse credibility than you.
column2: Tidak ada yang kredibilitasnya lebih buruk darimu.

column1: In the end, you were the first one to leave us!
column2: Ujung-ujungnya kau yang pertama meninggalkan kami!

column1: ...Hah, alright.
column2: ...Hah, baiklah.

column1: Although... it wouldn't be bad if things stayed like this.
column2: Meski... tidak buruk juga kalau keadaannya tetap seperti ini.

column1: But, there are other things to deal with, right?
column2: Tapi, ada hal lain yang harus diurus, kan?

column1: (Following Asteria's suddenly chilling gaze, we finally force our attention onto the most dangerous "anomaly" in this space.)
column2: (Mengikuti tatapan Asteria yang tiba-tiba mendingin, kami akhirnya memaksa perhatian kami ke "keganjilan" paling berbahaya di ruang ini.)

column1: (In the crimson space, a distinct spatial distortion was continuously spreading. And we knew exactly what was there.)
column2: (Di ruang merah tua itu, sebuah distorsi ruang yang jelas terus menyebar. Dan kami tahu tepat apa yang ada di sana.)

column1: ...That child named 'Ateraxis', she is very dangerous.
column2: ...Anak bernama 'Ateraxis' itu sangat berbahaya.

column1: Just because of her appearance, the Nirvana space underwent such a change, because besides Boojum cells, something else was put into her body.
column2: Hanya karena kemunculannya, ruang Nirvana berubah sebesar itu, karena selain sel Boojum, ada hal lain yang ditanam di tubuhnya.

column1: You'll understand once you actually fight her; she's the most powerful opponent we've encountered so far.
column2: Kau akan paham begitu benar-benar bertarung dengannya; dia lawan terkuat yang kami jumpai sejauh ini.

column1: But seeing you, I knew that things were far from being as simple as just being powerful.
column2: Tapi melihatmu, aku tahu urusannya jauh dari sesederhana sekadar kuat.

column1: Pure strength wouldn't be enough to make you appear here—I don't believe 'she' is kind enough to let you out just to catch up with us.
column2: Kekuatan semata tidak akan cukup membuatmu muncul di sini—aku tidak percaya 'dia' cukup baik hati melepaskanmu hanya untuk mengobrol dengan kami.

column1: Her danger stems not only from her power, but from her adaptability to Nirvana.
column2: Bahayanya bukan hanya berasal dari kekuatannya, tapi dari daya adaptasinya terhadap Nirvana.

column1: We can't let her enter the center of Nirvana, otherwise... something extremely tragic will happen to everyone, to every single person.
column2: Kita tidak boleh membiarkannya masuk ke pusat Nirvana, kalau tidak... sesuatu yang sangat tragis akan terjadi pada semua orang, pada setiap orang.

column1: In other words, we have to intercept her halfway...
column2: Dengan kata lain, kita harus mencegatnya di tengah jalan...

column1: Aha, then what are we waiting for! That guy is getting further and further away!
column2: Aha, kalau begitu apa lagi yang kita tunggu! Orang itu makin lama makin jauh!

column1: To think she delayed our reunion, I still have so many things I haven't finished saying to M4!
column2: Beraninya dia menunda reuni kami, masih banyak yang belum selesai kukatakan pada M4!

column1: Let's hurry up and chase after her! Watch me tear her to pieces, stop right there... Eh eh eh? Why is M4 stopping me!
column2: Ayo cepat kejar dia! Lihat aku mencabik-cabiknya, berhenti di situ... Eh eh eh? Kenapa M4 menahanku!

column1: (Looking at the traces left by Ateraxis, the already battle-hungry Soppo immediately wants to throw a punch and chase after her. However, before Soppo can start running, M4A1 grabs her jacket.)
column2: (Menatap jejak yang ditinggalkan Ateraxis, Soppo yang sudah kelaparan pertempuran langsung ingin melayangkan pukulan dan mengejarnya. Namun sebelum Soppo mulai berlari, M4A1 mencengkeram jaketnya.)

column1: Wait, Soppo. Before pursuing her... right now, I need your strength.
column2: Tunggu, Soppo. Sebelum mengejarnya... sekarang aku butuh kekuatan kalian.

column1: Uweh?
column2: Ueh?

column1: ...Though usually one should clean the house before considering hosting guests.
column2: ...Meski biasanya rumah dibersihkan dulu sebelum berpikir menjamu tamu.

column1: However, your... "her" house is a bit too dirty, isn't it?
column2: Namun rumah... "dia" ini agak terlalu kotor, ya?

column1: (M16 gazed into the distance.)
column2: (M16 menatap ke kejauhan.)

column1: (At the end of her line of sight, above the war-torn land, more strange colors that didn't belong here appeared.)
column2: (Di ujung garis pandangnya, di atas tanah yang koyak perang, muncul lebih banyak warna aneh yang bukan milik tempat ini.)

column1: (Bizarre creatures, like thick ink dropped into clear water, twisted and deformed, leaving spots of stains in this alternate space.)
column2: (Makhluk-makhluk ganjil, seperti tinta pekat yang diteteskan ke air jernih, memutar dan berubah bentuk, meninggalkan bercak-bercak noda di ruang lain ini.)

column1: (There were hunched figures that looked human but weren't, with numerous limbs; floating creatures made of multiple spheres; and constantly shifting, writhing polyhedral shadows—)
column2: (Ada figur bungkuk yang tampak manusia tapi bukan, dengan tungkai yang banyak; makhluk melayang yang tersusun dari beberapa bola; dan bayangan polihedral yang terus bergeser dan menggeliat—)

column1: I know it wouldn't be surprising to find anything in this godforsaken place.
column2: Aku tahu tidak aneh menemukan apa pun di tempat terkutuk ini.

column1: But this seems a bit out of bounds, doesn't it?
column2: Tapi ini sepertinya agak kelewatan, ya?

column1: That child cannot be accepted by Nirvana yet, but the cells in her body are therefore attempting adaptive evolution. This space has also been affected as a result, thereby deriving corresponding phenomena.
column2: Anak itu belum bisa diterima Nirvana, tapi sel-sel di tubuhnya karena itu mencoba melakukan evolusi adaptif. Ruang ini juga ikut terpengaruh, sehingga melahirkan fenomena yang sepadan.

column1: These phantoms are generated because of the diffusion of her will.
column2: Fantom-fantom itu terbentuk karena penyebaran kehendaknya.

column1: She... actually has the ability to interfere with Nirvana?
column2: Dia... ternyata punya kemampuan ikut campur pada Nirvana?

column1: Could it be that she can also... become an existence like you?
column2: Jangan-jangan dia juga bisa... menjadi eksistensi sepertimu?

column1: I need to borrow everyone's power to stop her, and before that...
column2: Aku perlu meminjam kekuatan kalian semua untuk menghentikannya, dan sebelum itu...

column1: The phantoms themselves are not real existences, they can only wander here aimlessly. They will weaken the stability between Nirvana and reality—therefore, before engaging in a showdown with that child, I hope everyone can assist me.
column2: Fantom itu sendiri bukan eksistensi nyata, mereka hanya bisa berkeliaran di sini tanpa tujuan. Mereka akan melemahkan kestabilan antara Nirvana dan kenyataan—karena itu, sebelum berhadapan langsung dengan anak itu, kuharap kalian semua bisa membantuku.

column1: What do you need us to do?
column2: Apa yang kau butuhkan dari kami?

column1: Just like in the past, Commander.
column2: Sama seperti dulu, Commander.

column1: Just like when you led us in the past.
column2: Sama seperti saat kau memimpin kami dulu.

column1: (M4A1 slowly raised her arms, palms facing upwards.)
column2: (M4A1 perlahan mengangkat kedua tangannya, telapak menghadap ke atas.)

column1: (Accompanied by a faint blue streamer, the exclusive assault rifle that had accompanied her through countless hellish battlefields completed its physical reconstruction in the air.)
column2: (Disertai pita cahaya biru samar, senapan serbu khususnya yang pernah menemaninya melewati medan tempur seneraka apa pun menyelesaikan rekonstruksi fisiknya di udara.)

column1: (She lowered her eyes, her fingertips sliding over the cold handguard and worn rails one by one. Finally, her five fingers suddenly closed, gripping the handle tightly.)
column2: (Dia menundukkan matanya, ujung jarinya meluncur satu per satu di pelindung tangan yang dingin dan rel yang sudah usang. Akhirnya kelima jarinya menutup mendadak, mencengkeram pegangannya kuat-kuat.)

column1: (With the crisp sound of the bolt locking, we all smiled in unison.)
column2: (Dengan bunyi nyaring kokang terkunci, kami semua tersenyum serentak.)

column1: ...Is today a complete nostalgia trip?
column2: ...Hari ini benar-benar perjalanan nostalgia, ya?

column1: She might be different, but for me, this "way" is still what I'm most accustomed to.
column2: Dia mungkin berbeda, tapi untukku, "cara" inilah yang paling kubiasakan.

column1: Heh, not bad.
column2: Heh, tidak buruk.

column1: As the first mission after our reunion.
column2: Sebagai misi pertama setelah reuni kita.

column1: I suppose it barely qualifies.
column2: Kurasa ini nyaris memenuhi syarat.

column1: Hmm? I don't really understand, but as long as I blow all these guys up, it's fine, right!
column2: Hmm? Aku tidak begitu paham, tapi selama semuanya kuledakkan, tidak masalah kan!

column1: The ratio of confirmed individuals to our numbers is about 1:200... Besides, looking at this behavioral state, will they really attack us?
column2: Rasio individu yang terkonfirmasi terhadap jumlah kita sekitar 1:200... Selain itu, dilihat dari pola perilakunya, apa mereka benar-benar akan menyerang kita?

column1: Although they don't possess true consciousness, they are projections of existence. We'll probably be attacked once we get close to them.
column2: Meski mereka tidak punya kesadaran sejati, mereka proyeksi dari eksistensi. Kita kemungkinan akan diserang begitu mendekat.

column1: (Robella scanned the battlefield, and after confirming the numerical gap between the enemy and us, her gaze rested on her most trusted companions.)
column2: (Robella memindai medan tempur, dan setelah memastikan selisih jumlah antara musuh dan kami, tatapannya berhenti pada rekan-rekan yang paling dia percaya.)

column1: It's really tricky, but... at this moment, I don't feel like I'll lose to anyone.
column2: Ini benar-benar rumit, tapi... saat ini aku tidak merasa akan kalah dari siapa pun.

column1: (And these trustworthy companions also showed relaxed expressions one after another.)
column2: (Dan rekan-rekan yang bisa dipercaya itu juga memperlihatkan ekspresi rileks satu demi satu.)

column1: —It's 'we' won't lose to anyone, right?
column2: —Yang benar 'kita' tidak akan kalah dari siapa pun, kan?

column1: The AR Team, and the Commander, since we're all here.
column2: AR Team, dan Commander, karena kita semua ada di sini.

column1: There's nothing that can stop us—ten years ago, when we turned half the world upside down, these guys were still eating dust who knows where.
column2: Tidak ada yang bisa menghentikan kita—sepuluh tahun lalu, saat kita menjungkirkan separuh dunia, mereka ini masih makan debu di entah mana.

column1: Commander, please...
column2: Commander, silakan...

column1: Ah! Wait a minute! Wait a minute!
column2: Ah! Tunggu dulu! Tunggu dulu!

column1: (Soppo waved her arms, making a big X sign.)
column2: (Soppo mengibaskan kedua tangannya, membentuk tanda X besar.)

column1: What are you trying to do at a time like this...
column2: Kau mau apa di saat seperti ini...

column1: This is the assembly of the AR Team! Shouldn't it be a bit more formal!
column2: Ini pengumpulan AR Team! Seharusnya sedikit lebih resmi kan!

column1: At a time like this you're still...
column2: Di saat seperti ini kau masih...

column1: No, you have a point.
column2: Tidak, kau ada benarnya.

column1: ...No, although I understand the logic, for you to agree with Soppo so frankly...
column2: ...Tidak, meski aku paham logikanya, kau menyetujui Soppo seterus-terangan itu...

column1: Oh, this is the Nirvana space, it really wouldn't be strange if the sun rose from the west here.
column2: Oh, ini ruang Nirvana, tidak aneh kalau di sini matahari terbit dari barat.

column1: Waaaaah, that was M16 and Robella! I really haven't said anything this time!
column2: Huwaaaa, itu M16 dan Robella! Kali ini aku benar-benar belum bilang apa pun!

column1: I already know what you want to say, so just shut up forever now.
column2: Aku sudah tahu apa yang mau kau katakan, jadi tutup mulutmu selamanya sekarang.

column1: M4! Commander! Help me!
column2: M4! Commander! Tolong aku!

column1: (Watching Soppo quickly hide behind M4A1 makes me involuntarily recall the scene of our first meeting.)
column2: (Melihat Soppo cepat bersembunyi di belakang M4A1 membuatku tanpa sadar mengingat adegan pertemuan pertama kami.)

column1: (M4A1 seems to feel the same way I do, the corners of her mouth turning up slightly.)
column2: (M4A1 sepertinya merasakan hal yang sama denganku, sudut mulutnya terangkat sedikit.)

column1: Everyone is right, this is a very memorable moment.
column2: Semuanya benar, ini momen yang sangat berkesan.

column1: There's still enough time, so let's do it just like in the past.
column2: Waktunya masih cukup, jadi mari lakukan seperti dulu.

column1: Since we're making it official, I'll start things off!
column2: Karena kita membuatnya resmi, aku yang membuka!

column1: M16A1—Beluga. If you have any missions, just leave them to me!
column2: M16A1—Beluga. Kalau ada misi, serahkan saja padaku!

column1: M4 SOPMOD II—Soppo, Commander, hehehe, I finally get to see you and everyone again!
column2: M4 SOPMOD II—Soppo, Commander, hehehe, akhirnya aku bisa bertemu kau dan semuanya lagi!

column1: ST AR-15—Asteria, officially rejoining the team. Please watch me as you did in the past, and recognize my value together with me.
column2: ST AR-15—Asteria, resmi bergabung kembali ke tim. Tolong perhatikan aku seperti dulu, dan akui nilaiku bersamaku.

column1: RO635—Robella, standing by, awaiting your orders as always.
column2: RO635—Robella, bersiaga, menunggu perintahmu seperti biasa.

column1: M4A1, AR Team. Five members expected, five members present.
column2: M4A1, AR Team. Lima anggota seharusnya, lima anggota hadir.

column1: Commander, we'll leave the rest to you.
column2: Commander, sisanya kami serahkan padamu.

column1: Please give your orders.
column2: Silakan beri perintahmu.

column1: (A joining line that was similar yet different from memory.)
column2: (Kalimat lapor diri yang mirip tapi berbeda dari ingatan.)

column1: (Five people who were similar yet different from memory.)
column2: (Lima orang yang mirip tapi berbeda dari ingatan.)

column1: (A mission that was similar yet different from memory.)
column2: (Misi yang mirip tapi berbeda dari ingatan.)

column1: (The world has changed beyond recognition, but only one sentence anchors us here.)
column2: (Dunia sudah berubah sampai tak dikenali, tapi hanya satu kalimat yang menjangkarkan kami di sini.)

column1: (Only one identity remains unshakable in this moment, in the past, and in the future.)
column2: (Hanya satu identitas yang tetap tak tergoyahkan saat ini, di masa lalu, dan di masa depan.)

column1: (At this moment, this is the only thing that only I can do.)
column2: (Saat ini, inilah satu-satunya hal yang hanya bisa kulakukan.)

column1: (In her glossy, moist eyes, I saw my own body—it seemed to be undergoing some kind of change from being pulled into Nirvana.)
column2: (Di matanya yang berkilau dan lembap, aku melihat tubuhku sendiri—sepertinya tubuh itu sedang mengalami semacam perubahan karena tertarik ke Nirvana.)

column1: (Obviously, 'she' couldn't wait any longer—the time left for me to say goodbye was only a tiny bit.)
column2: (Jelas 'dia' tidak bisa menunggu lebih lama—waktu yang tersisa untuk berpamitan hanya sedikit sekali.)

column1: (Those phantoms kept writhing, exuding a dangerous aura—I even had a premonition that if I got too close to them, even I would be assimilated into the same existence.)
column2: (Fantom-fantom itu terus menggeliat, memancarkan aura yang berbahaya—aku bahkan punya pertanda bahwa kalau aku terlalu dekat dengan mereka, aku pun akan diasimilasi menjadi eksistensi yang sama.)

column1: (I instantly understood the reason why even M4 was wary of them. Just by existing in Nirvana—they could cause unpredictable harm.)
column2: (Aku seketika paham alasan bahkan M4 mewaspadai mereka. Hanya dengan berada di Nirvana—mereka bisa menimbulkan bahaya yang tidak bisa diprediksi.)
